comment.body: Thanks for attaching five FileLocksmithUI dumps and the environment details; they establish that this is a repeated native crash. To determine whether it is the handle-enumeration race tracked in #49789 or a separate administrator-retry failure, please retest on the latest stable or Preview build and give one numbered sequence, including the selected file/folder type and whether the crash occurs before or after choosing the administrator option. Immediately after that crash, add a comment containing `/bugreport` so the generated ZIP captures the matching File Locksmith and runner logs.
